title: Split the brother_printer cups_service test modules under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring test_cups_service.py (390 lines), test_cups_service_part2.py (261) and test_cups_service_part3.py (260) under the repo-wide 250-line cap by partitioning them at class and method boundaries, and rename the part-numbered survivors after the concern they cover.
acceptance_criteria: Every cups_service and _cups_fallback test module is at most 250 lines.
The brother_printer suite still reports exactly 402 passing tests -- the same count as before the split, proving no test was dropped or silently skipped.
The package keeps 100% branch coverage of the brother_printer source modules.
No MOD constant changes: the source split in the previous commit already put every patched name in the module these files name.
No assertion is changed and no test is deleted, skipped or weakened; whole classes and whole methods move verbatim and only the import blocks are adjusted.
No suppression is added and no coverage exclusion is introduced.
out_of_scope: Touching the brother_printer source, which is already under the cap.
Splitting test_display.py, test_usb_query.py, test_check_brother_printer.py or the consumables pair, which are separate commits.
Introducing a shared conftest.py; these classes build their mocks inline and need no shared fixture builders.
verifier: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/brother_printer/tests -q (expects exactly 402 passed), plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files, plus bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all for the cap.
